name: Iso-Lateral Incline Press (IL-IP)
source: Four ordered side-view frames from the official Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral Incline Press demonstration (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UKPBc1BWRzw, 0:26.6–0:27.4). Near-side independent workarm loaded with two 45 lb (40.82 kg) plates.

observation.evidence: Official Life Fitness / Hammer Strength side-view demonstration (YouTube UKPBc1BWRzw, 0:26.6–0:27.4) of the Plate-Loaded Iso-Lateral Incline Press (IL-IP). The near-side workarm (lifter's left arm) is tracked through four ordered positions of a single continuous upward press (bottom to top lockout) with two 45 lb Hammer Strength plates (40.82 kg) loaded on the arm. The pivot is the center of the upper two-bolt flange bearing housing supporting the workarm (tracked per frame to account for the slight horizontal camera dolly slide across the 0.8 s clip). The loading horn center (plate mass center) and handle grip contact are rigidly welded to the single rotating lever arm. Because Hammer Strength Iso-Lateral arms have a slight converging axis tilt (~10–15 deg out of the sagittal plane), this perpendicular side projection approximates the true 3D arc as a planar lever; frame-to-frame radius ratio and offset consistency verify the planar approximation.

base_resistance.source: Hammer Strength lists 8 lbs (3.6 kg) starting resistance per workarm for the IL-IP. Unloaded curve across the stroke is unmeasured and held constant by default.
